newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish purchasing managers' index 57.4 in April.
newsitem.headline: Swedish purchasing managers' index 57.4 in April.

text.p: Sweden's I&L and Swedbank purchasing managers' index (ICI) for April rose to 57.4 from 55.5 in March, the groups said on Friday.

"This shows partly that the upturn in the Swedish manufacturing industry is continuing, partly that the business cycle is improving further compared with the first few months of last year," Swedbank and I&L said in a statement.
"It is more and more clear that the industrial business cycle is entering a positive phase," it said.
It said the upturn was moderate, however.
The statement also said real production and order intake data was also positive.
"It shows activity levels in industry have increased gradually in the spring and that company's order stocks have been replenished," they said.
They said the improvement was from the export side and that the domestic market was still weak.
"Another sign of the increasing economic activity is that suppliers' delivery times are increasing," they said.
